coverage_notes.search_limitations: Targeted search returned largely pre-window incidents, nonqualifying business/holiday closures, routine assistance announcements, and historical 2025 SNAP funding issues. No post-window qualifying event could be directly established; national completeness is not asserted. Search queries were date-targeted rather than time-restricted by search API.
